# Contract: Reset Action

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: a0048076-0ae1-42e8-b25c-9d53f1b17c55 | Date: 2026-01-26 -->

## Overview

Archives current session and cleans up old archives based on retention policy.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `-Action` | string | Yes | - | Must be "Reset" |
| `-SkipCleanup` | switch | No | false | Skip automatic archive cleanup |

## Behavior

1. If `agent-metrics.json` exists:
   - Create `archive/` directory if needed
   - Copy to `archive/agent-metrics-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.json`
   - Remove active metrics file
2. Run archive cleanup (FR-020):
   - Load settings for retention period (default 7 days)
   - Delete archives older than retention period
   - Report deleted count
3. Output confirmation

## Archive Naming

Pattern: `agent-metrics-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.json`

Example: `agent-metrics-20260126-153045.json`

## Cleanup Logic

```powershell
$settings = Get-MetricsSettings
$retentionDays = $settings.retention.archiveDays  # default: 7
$cutoffDate = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$retentionDays)

Get-ChildItem "$archiveDir/agent-metrics-*.json" |
    Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt $cutoffDate } |
    Remove-Item
```

## Preconditions

- None (safe to call even without active session)

## Postconditions

- Active session archived (if existed)
- Old archives removed per retention policy
- Ready for new Init

## Example

```powershell
.\agent-metrics.ps1 -Action Reset
```

## Output

```text
Metrics archived to: .specify/metrics/archive/agent-metrics-20260126-153045.json
Cleaned up 3 archive(s) older than 7 days.
Metrics reset for next phase.
```

## Error Handling

| Error | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| No metrics file | Output "No metrics to reset" |
| Cannot create archive dir | Exit with error |
| Cannot delete old archives | Log warning, continue |
